## CIEC-12(c)

### Question

Please provide Mr. Velez's estimate of the annual reduction in distribution and transmission revenue attributable solely to the automatic enrollment of existing heat pump customers.

### Response

That estimate is in the responses to CIEC-1(a) and CIEC-3(c). The number of existing customers in those estimates is derived in the response to CIEC-1(b).

The response to CIEC-1(a) gives the annual reduction for one existing heat pump customer, split into distribution and transmission. The Existing row of the floor table and of the ceiling table multiplies that reduction by the number of existing customers who would be enrolled. Each later row keeps that Existing amount and adds the reduction from customers who install a heat pump in 2027 through 2031.

The response to CIEC-1(b) derives the floor and the ceiling for how many existing heat pump customers would be automatically enrolled. The floor is the Company's count of customers it can identify from rebates and from its Conservation and Load Management forecast. The ceiling applies the heat-pump share from the Connecticut Residential Appliance Saturation Survey to the Rate Year residential customer count.

The response to CIEC-3(c) states the annual distribution and transmission reduction for existing customers alone. Its revenue table runs from the CIEC-1(b) floor to the ceiling, in steps of 20 percent, and separates distribution from transmission. Each row uses the per-customer revenue reduction from CIEC-1(a).
